title: Peer Review & Feedback
subtitle: Submit anonymous feedback regarding your colleagues' collaborative efforts
privacyBody: Peer submissions are 100% anonymized. Your comments are automatically encrypted on submission, and your user ID is hashed using a cycle-specific security salt. No supervisors or HR representatives can trace these scores back to you.
teamworkDesc: Evaluates readiness to help, collaboration, and team engagement.
commDesc: Evaluates communication clarity, transparency, and collaboration.
feedbackPlaceholder: Write anonymous constructive feedback to enhance team environment...
validationDesc: Hash-based verification active to prevent duplicate submissions.
successMsg: Peer review submitted successfully and anonymized!
errorMsg: Failed to submit evaluation. Please make sure you have not already evaluated this colleague in this cycle.
noColleagues: No colleagues found in your department.
selectCycleAlert: Please select a performance cycle first.
noActiveCycleDesc: Peer reviews and feedback can only be submitted during active performance cycles initiated by HR.
